The Game Awards 2026 is an upcoming award show set to honor the best video games of 2026. It will be the thirteenth show hosted by Geoff Keighley, creator and producer of the Game Awards, set to be held with a live audience at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles on December 10, 2026, and live streamed across online platforms globally.
Background
As with previous iterations of the Game Awards, the 2026 show will be hosted and produced by Canadian games journalist Geoff Keighley. The presentation is set to take place at the Peacock Theater in Los Angeles on December 10, 2026.
